name: flare
description: FLARE: flood alerts that know where you are (hackathon demo, simulated scenario)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.start: npm run build -w client && npm start -w server
